verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his Q-into-E combo or stand in his W cone-of-fire for the empowered auto; you win by matching his CS and only committing when his Q (Volcanic Rupture) and E (Searing Charge) are both down.

brief.thesis: Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture, 800 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cd) slows and drops a delayed magma pillar, and his E (Searing Charge, 450 range, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s cd) can close that gap and chain into a terrain-collision shockwave knock-up — that Q-into-E combo, plus a Brittle-empowered auto off W (Bellows Breath), is exactly what OP.GG's own note tells you to dodge rather than trade into. Malphite's Q (Seismic Shard, 625 range, 8s cd) out-ranges his E but not his Q, so the lane is decided by who gets to fight at the range they want.

theirWindow.when: right after his Q slow lands
theirWindow.what: He can immediately chain E through the slow for the terrain shockwave knock-up, and if W's final gout already tagged you with Brittle the follow-up auto spikes hard — walk back out past 450 range instead of trading autos here.

yourWindow.when: his Q and E both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step in and land your own Q (Seismic Shard) for the slow, then E (Ground Slam) for the attack-speed cut — he has no gap-closer or slow left to punish you, and Ground Slam's damage scales off your own Armor so the trade only improves as you build tank.

start.why: Measured at 53.2% win rate over 314 games in this matchup — the regen-on-hit and damage reduction against his autos and Q poke matter more here than the Doran's Ring mana sustain, since you're not looking to all-in before level 6.

boots.why: 50.2% win rate over 850 games and the majority pick (52.6%) — the flat auto-attack reduction cuts the damage from the empowered W auto and any extended trades, which matters more than his ability damage alone.

core.why: Highest-winrate opener in the 53.1%-WR path, giving you the HP and burn damage to punish him for standing in melee range during your Ground Slam windows.
Second item in the same 53.1%/81-game path — punishes his auto-attack trading pattern and the W auto specifically.
Closes out the 53.1% core path with armor plus the attack-speed slow, further dulling his damage output in extended fights.

situational.when: his team stacks burst magic damage and you need the shield-on-low-HP spike protection
you need more AoE pressure and sustain for extended skirmishes around objectives
you're ahead and want to amplify Unstoppable Force for pick potential rather than pure tankiness

runes.keystoneWhy: The 51.6%-WR page (37.2% pick) — the proc heal and permanent HP growth fit a lane where OP.GG's own advice is to farm rather than fight. Master-tier Malphite players instead run Arcane Comet (Sorcery, 16,740 games) for the burst poke whenever he dodges in close for a trade; that suits you only if you're confident disengaging after the poke rather than tank-trading.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 81.5% and the measured best performer at 48.1% WR — Teleport lets you commit fully to farming through his zoning Q without giving up map presence, which is the whole point of this matchup. Flash+Ignite (44.6% WR, 16.3% pick) is the alternative if you want to punish an overextended Ornn directly instead.

playing.title: Farm, don't force fights
playing.detail: The 47.8% head-to-head over 1426 games and OP.GG's own tip both say the same thing: match his CS and let the matchup swing with items rather than trying to out-duel him early.

playing.title: Respect the Q-E combo
playing.detail: Never sit still inside 450 range once his Q has landed — that's the exact window his Searing Charge chains into a knock-up shockwave off terrain.

playing.title: Don't facecheck his W wind-up
playing.detail: Bellows Breath's final gout applies Brittle before his empowered auto lands; back off the moment you see him channeling it toward you.

playing.title: Trade only on cooldown windows
playing.detail: Only step up for a Q-into-E exchange of your own once you've confirmed both his Q and E are down — without them he has no way to punish you.

playing.title: Rush Sunfire for the burn trade
playing.detail: Sunfire Aegis' passive damage rewards you for standing in range during his E charge-ins, which otherwise cost you nothing to walk away from.

playing.title: Hold Flash for his E, not engages
playing.detail: Save Flash to dodge the Searing Charge terrain knock-up rather than for aggression — losing it early just opens you up to the full combo.

brief.patchCaveat: The win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade windows are the author's own interpretation of the ability text.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo and his (W) – basic attack. Rather than fighting him, focus on farming lane to gain lane control.
